notes: News alerts now sound on time, every time, including when the chart is minimized.
changelog: The alert sound now plays with the default settings. Before, alerts only showed in the Alerts log.
Alerts keep sounding when the chart is minimized or in the background, and you no longer get a burst of late alerts when you bring it back.
Each alert sounds once, at its set time, on every chart type, including tick, range, Renko and volume charts.
The alert message shows the real minutes left until the release.
Alerts work in Playback and Market Replay, and alerts for events just after midnight are no longer missed.
Network paths in Alert Sound File are now ignored for safety.
